source_title: Amazon's Lord of the Rings Gandalf Costume Has Dropped to Its Lowest Price of the Year
source_excerpt:
Arrives before Halloween for Prime members.
October 31 is nearly here and time is running out to buy yourself a costume. This is the week that Spirit Halloween starts to look fully picked over and popular costumes become incredibly scarce. Thankfully, If you happen to have an Amazon Prime membership, there are a number of options still available that will actually ship to you on time. And if you're a Lord of the Rings fan specifically, this official Gandalf costume is an excellent choice for the price.
Rubies Lord Of The Rings: Gandalf Costume for Adults
At $36.33 for the XL size, it's surprisingly affordable for an officially licensed costume. It doesn't come with a fake beard or a wig, but if you already have either of those things then you're set. And if you don't, you should be able to find that still in stock somewhere before Halloween.
The costume you are buying here is specifically the robe, hat, and belt that were designed after the iconic wizard from Middle-earth. This is a version of Gandalf the Gray, as seen in The Hobbit movie , rather than the more majestic Gandalf the White we got in the later LOTR movies . Like most affordable costumes, it's made of 100% polyester, which means you probably don't want to toss it into the wash with the rest of your clothes.
The main issue with this costume, like I mentioned above, is that it isn't exactly complete. If you want to look like Gandalf and not just some random wizard, you will need a gray beard and a gray wig. You'll also likely want some sort of gnarled staff, which can honestly just be a cool tree branch you find in the forest. Thankfully Amazon also has a perfect wig and beard combo in stock that will arrive before Halloween.
Kangaroo Gray Wizard Costume Wig with Fake Beard & Mustache
When Is the Last Day to Buy a Costume on Amazon?
At the time of writing, this costume is eligible for two-day Prime shipping, which means it will arrive three days before the actual holiday. Not everything at Amazon is available that fast, but you can assume that there will always be something available within that two-day window on Amazon. That means the last day to buy a costume online is likely October 29, but that will be cutting it really close.
